rpmDescription: ASCII-armored OpenPGP public key trusted to sign this RPM remote's repository metadata (repomd.xml). When set, curation sync verifies the upstream signature before ingesting. This is the proxy-verification trusted key, not a server-side signing key.
rpmExisting: A trusted key is configured. Entering a new key below replaces it.
proxyFiltersHint: Comma-separated allowlists for a Debian proxy. Leave empty (or use *) to proxy everything. Architecture-independent (all) packages are always permitted.
releaseMetadataHint: Optional fields written into generated Release files.
label: Label
allowedScopesHint: Comma or newline-separated @scope literals. Empty leaves the repository unrestricted by scope.
allowedPatternsHint: Additive glob patterns (*/?). A name is allowed if its scope is allowed OR any pattern matches.
allowUnscopedHint: Permit bare (non-@scope) package names to resolve.
